description: This file defines the 'Exception' class within the 'device' namespace, used for handling exceptions in the device settings module. It includes constructors, methods to retrieve message and error code, and overrides the 'what()' method from std::exception.

classes.name: device::Exception
classes.description: A class that represents exceptions in the device settings module, with capabilities to store an error message and code, and to provide information about the exception.

methods.name: Exception(const char *msg = "No Message for this exception")
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error message.

methods.name: Exception(int err, const char *msg = "No Message for this Exception")
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error code and message.

methods.name: const std::string & getMessage() const
methods.description: Returns the error message string associated with the exception.

methods.name: int getCode() const
methods.description: Returns the error code associated with the exception.

methods.name: const char * what() const
methods.description: Returns a C-string of the error message, overriding std::exception::what().

methods.name: Exception(const char * msg="No Message for this exception")
Exception(int err,const char * msg="No Message for this Exception")
